parameters.name: FirewallSwitch
parameters.description:
The status of the VPC firewall. Valid values:

- **open**: Enable.

- **close**: Disable.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the request and response. Valid values:

- **zh** (default): Chinese.

- **en**: English.

parameters.name: MemberUid
parameters.description: The UID of the member account.

parameters.name: VpcFirewallId
parameters.description:
The instance ID of the VPC firewall.

> You can call the [DescribeVpcFirewallCenList](~~345777~~) operation to query the instance ID of the VPC firewall.
